gse244832.allowed_use: Observed-ATAC held-query representation and donor-compatible RNA-ATAC integration after dataset activation and a separate TaskSpec. RNA and ATAC are separate nuclei from matched donors.
gse244832.model_access: When held, no GSE244832 cell, peak call, IDF contribution, SVD fit, label, prototype, classifier fit, or calibration may enter the model. Never infer cell pairing.

gse281367.allowed_use: Observed-ATAC representation within donor-grouped development folds after native-reference, peak, fragment, donor, and TaskSpec gates pass.
gse281367.model_access: When held, its 12 donors contribute neither peaks nor any fitted statistic. Cells are not biological replicates.

gse289173.allowed_use: None under current LSI routes because the sealed row universe contains snRNA and evaluator-only eQTL/ieQTL summaries but no ATAC peak matrix.
gse289173.model_access: No sealed feature or outcome access. LSI cannot transform RNA-only rows and cannot produce signed variant effects.

gse296875.allowed_use: Outer-fold same-nucleus ATAC representation and donor-compatible RNA-ATAC diagnostics after donor/well/reference/peak/QC/missingness gates pass.
gse296875.model_access: Only outer-training donors may define peaks, feature filtering, IDF, SVD, component policy, heads, or calibration. Held nuclei receive transform-only observed-ATAC inference.

local_model_roster.missingness: Unavailable assays, unresolved feature crosswalks, failed-QC rows, and unassayed regions are explicit missingness. Only measured zero counts on frozen peaks are numeric zeros.
local_model_roster.runtime_identity: scikit-learn 1.9.0 at 77def0ed6e3beab57244885d2a584470e96c103d using the registered wheel hash

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells, nuclei, peaks, wells, and LSI coordinates are not independent replicates.
rules.local_training: Every IDF/SVD/head artifact is continual_seen only for its declared outer-training donors and target-label-unexposed for a held source only when all fitted state excludes that source.
rules.pairing: GSE296875 is same-nucleus. GSE244832 is same-sample different aliquot and permits donor-level alignment only.
rules.query_mapping: A held query uses the exact training peak order, IDF, normalization formula, and SVD transform. Query IDF recomputation or SVD refitting is prohibited.
